author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-17 09:42: "yup write sabotage". The first Delve of the old MB19/MB20 Sabotage families (backport-map.md: no Delve yet, fits today).
_note: SABOTAGE, QUIETLY. The old MB19c line is the spine: 'Do not smash the Ecliptic scanners. Sabotage them quietly, so
the mercenaries keep trusting a picture of <Planet> that stopped being true.' The one old verb that is a trick, not
a fight, so this one has no fight: the array is unmanned at an abandoned site and feeds an Ecliptic camp elsewhere.
It answers the player's pacifist ask (2026-10-10). No failure state, no timer (his rule).
Issuer: settlers the Ecliptic are watching, who want to move without being seen. The board card is theirs
(style guide 33 s4: we, payer on line one, flat, stock closer).
Three scanners in ANY ORDER behind one counted objective (remote03a's shape), so no journal line says first or last.
Ends on a group, so the closing radio is recapSay (his 2026-10-17: the close is a radio).
MODEL IS A STAND-IN: SeismicSensor01 (vanilla, used by 01a). Kim's F9 'Scanner array' is unbuilt; her eye owed.
Pay: med, placeholder (a three-part job, no fight); the tier is his.

place._theme: A quiet (non-hostile) site, so nobody shoots and the job stays quiet; the array is unmanned. Abandoned-only was a pool of 4 (lint, 2026-10-17), too narrow. The board places the POI, so it always starts (his, 2026-10-12).

prose.name: Sabotage: Ecliptic Scanners on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The Ecliptic have a scanner array at the <Place> watching everything that moves on <Planet>. The settlers who posted the job don't want it broken. They want it lying.
prose.card: Local Contract. The Ecliptic are watching <Planet> through a scanner array at the <Place>, and we need them watching the wrong thing. Do not smash it. Feed each scanner a false reading and leave it running. Payment on completion.

recap: The Ecliptic scanners at the <Place> are all still running, and all three are wrong. Whatever the mercenaries think is happening on <Planet>, it isn't.
recapSay: Their camp's just logged three empty valleys and a dust storm.
We moved everything this morning. Nobody so much as looked up.

beats.objective: Feed false readings to the Ecliptic scanners at the <Place>
beats.journal: This scanner was tracking movement on the ground. I looped an hour of empty footage into it. It's still recording, just not anything real.
beats.name: Ecliptic Motion Scanner

beats.journal: This one counted ships landing and taking off. I set it to read a dust storm. Nobody flies in a dust storm, so nobody will wonder why it's quiet.
beats.name: Ecliptic Landing Scanner

beats.journal: This scanner logged heat signatures. I shifted its calibration so a whole settlement reads as warm rock. It will be right about the rock.
beats.name: Ecliptic Thermal Scanner

broadcast: A broken scanner gets fixed. A scanner that's wrong gets believed.
_speech: The issuer on the radio once the job is taken. Voice is 05a and 18a's (wCizWKvnaS3LOIUwHo98); his ear decides. Radio rules: no names, no places, no factions spoken, no currency.
